fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk (SNDK) could reach $1,600 per share by 2027 (pre-split basis), offering 87% upside but falling short of Wall Street consensus target of $2,047; stock has declined 42% monthly from current $857.79.
fields.summary_ko.1: SanDisk posted Q1 2027 revenue of $11.03 billion (YoY +377.9%), GAAP gross margin of 85%, and 61% QoQ increase in datacenter revenue, achieving seven consecutive quarters of EPS beats versus consensus.
